description: This file contains a Python module that defines classes and functions for interacting with BuildBot, fetching layout test results from Google Storage, and managing build information. It includes classes such as Build and BuildBot, and functions for URL generation, fetching results, and filtering builds.

classes.name: Build
classes.description: Represents a build with a builder name and optional build number. If build number is None, it indicates the latest build for that builder.

classes.name: BuildBot
classes.description: Provides methods to generate URLs for build results, fetch retry summaries, and layout test results from Google Storage, and includes internal methods for URL construction and file fetching.

methods.name: results_url
methods.description: Returns a URL for archived layout test results for a specific build, either for a particular build number or the latest.

methods.name: builder_results_url_base
methods.description: Constructs the base URL for a builder's directory in Google Storage, transforming the builder name to be URL-friendly.

methods.name: fetch_retry_summary_json
methods.description: Fetches and returns the retry summary JSON content for a given build, memoized for efficiency.

methods.name: accumulated_results_url_base
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the accumulated layout test results for a builder.

methods.name: latest_layout_test_results
methods.description: Fetches the latest layout test results for a builder, memoized.

methods.name: fetch_results
methods.description: Fetches layout test results for a specific build, memoized.

methods.name: fetch_layout_test_results
methods.description: Fetches layout test results from a URL and returns a LayoutTestResults object, memoized.

methods.name: _fetch_file
methods.description: Internal method to fetch a file's content from a URL, returns None if not found.
